review: The Manager of La Manchaland Don Quixote or Manager Don in short, is a very potent DPS Identity that synergizes very well with other Bloodfiends IDs and the Bloodfeast mechanic. This allows Manager Don to enhance her skills and effectively possess 8 unique skills. Before we start, let's discuss her unique mechanic first. Like other Bloodfiends IDs, she has a unique stackable status called Hardblood. When Manager Don or another ally consumes Bloodfeast she will gain 2 Hardblood. This amount of Hardblood can also be gained if another ally takes Bleed damage up to a maximum of 3 times per turn. Hardblood status has 3 stages which change with every 10 Hardblood stacks gained and provide the following benefits: - Raise Min & Max Speed values by 1 for every 10 Hardblood stacks. - At Hardblood II, gain 1 Offense Level Up for every 5 stacks of Hardblood at turn start. - At Hardblood III, gain 1
